experiment: BPM aligned theta and three nested percentile tiers
reference: Frozen final-season candidates with finite BPM, 2011–2021; same candidate identities as the BPM baseline
performance_scale: BPM standardized by season on the full eligible available roster, sample SD; theta and band ranks both use these standardized values among final-season candidates
roster_calculation: Compute relevance and shared/LOO averages on the full available eligible team-season roster BEFORE focal band filtering
ties: Stable source-order rank-first allocation for fixed-count bands, including lower boundaries; report actual number above/equal theta and any split ties
changes: theta reference changes from roster observations to final-season candidates
band ranking changes from raw BPM to standardized BPM
replace adjacent equal-width top/next bands with top 2%, next 8%, next 20%
interpretation: Joint redesign of reference and bands, not a single-parameter causal comparison. No outcome-based tuning.
next_step: Compare plots, then discuss one finding at a time. No 2.5% run or new minutes cutoff in this experiment.
